UNEMPLOYMENT INSURANCE WEEKLY CLAIMS
SEASONALLY ADJUSTED DATA
In the week ending December 28, the advance figure for seasonally adjusted
initial claims was 211,000, a decrease of 9,000 from the previous week's
revised level. The previous week's level was revised up by 1,000 from 219,000
to 220,000.
The advance seasonally adjusted insured unemployment rate was 1.2 percent for
the week ending December 21.
